title: Grateful Dead Live at Electric Theater on 1969-07-04
lineage: SBD > MC > D >CD > Soundforge pitch correction > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard source riddled with tape hiss and splices, yet a surprisingly solid Casey Jones provides the sole bright spot in this rough early‑'69 set.
ai_review.review: The recording is plagued by audible tape hiss, numerous cuts and splices, and deteriorates after “Me & My Uncle,” making most of the show difficult to enjoy.  Musically it’s a transitional mid‑summer ’69 performance with embryonic versions of future staples and a few dead‑end experiments, but the rendition of “Casey Jones” is praised for its energy and clear guitar work.

ai_rating.rationale: Two low‑star reviews focus on severe audio flaws while a single high‑star review highlights one song’s good sound; overall the show is historically interesting but hampered by poor recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape hiss throughout, multiple cuts/splices, and a gnarly drop in fidelity after “Me & My Uncle”; only the “Casey Jones” segment is noted as relatively clear.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A transitional mid‑'69 set featuring early versions of songs that would become staples, with some experimental numbers (e.g., Slewfoot, Let Me In) that feel unfinished.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar tone and vocal delivery are specifically praised on the “Casey Jones” performance.
band_member_comments.Keys: An organ‑like background is mentioned during the praised “Casey Jones” segment.
